Attackers can register a colon-form system:Patient.read client that bypasses approval, then request unregistered system/Patient.write scope to read, modify, and create Patient records.

item.description: Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains a denylist bypass in system/traits/media.php where '.phar' is misconfigured with a leading dot, allowing authenticated administrators to upload .phar PHP files. item.title: CVE-2026-126378 (critical 9.1): Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses
item.description: Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a file upload vulnerability in the theme installer validFile() function that uses strpos() instead of strict path matching. item.title: CVE-2026-126315 (critical 9.8): Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's
item.description: Frappe HRMS 16.14.0 before 16.20.1 sends product usage events on certain HR transactions without checking the site's telemetry setting, and some events include more detail than needed. item.title: CVE-2026-127277 (critical 10.0): A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. The affected element is an unknown function
item.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. The affected element is an unknown function of the file etc/init.d/service_smbd.sh of the component SMB Service. item.description: A vulnerability was determined in Linksys EA8100 1.0.3.216940. item.title: CVE-2026-126812 (critical 9.8): blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 contains an insecure default configuration in its Docker Compose examples
item.description: blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.7 contains an insecure default configuration in its Docker Compose examples that sets MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes in database.env and publishes MariaDB on port 3306.
